label: POST_W12_RETROSPECTIVE_QUALITATIVE_CASE_STUDY
notice: Retrospective, outcome-selected explanatory case studies, not confirmation or population failure frequencies. Gold annotations are diagnostic only and were not available to the allocator. No allocation, predictor, threshold or answer is changed. The BEA_V2 preregistered calibration remains CALIBRATION_FAILED_TERMINATED; the V2 answers come from the separately labelled post-hoc tau=8e-5 study.

selection_rules.budget_reversal: strict pairwise method-order inversions with both absolute QA margins >=0.01 (SciFact correctness margins >=1), then largest change in pairwise score margin, then ascending query ID; one query/dataset only if an inversion qualifies
selection_rules.maximum_disagreement: largest per-query score spread; for SciFact @256 prefer FIXED-only correct and @1024 V1-only correct among equal spreads; then ascending query ID
selection_rules.near_tie: spread <=0.01, max score >0, with token range >=10% budget or minimum pairwise underlying-sentence Jaccard <=0.5; smallest spread, largest allocation difference, highest max score, query ID; prefer unused eligible query; absent eligibility is explicitly flagged
selection_rules.score: QA per-query F1; SciFact binary correctness, never per-query macro-F1
selection_rules.selection_bias: up to 18 primary case slots plus 3 budget reversals; duplicate query/budget cases are disclosed and frequencies also use unique query/budget units
selection_rules.v2_rescue: positive V2−V1 first, largest delta, then number of other methods beating V1, largest spread, query ID; prefer unused query among positive candidates; if none positive explicitly mark no positive rescue
